meta.title: inkrip | PDF Printing Tool
meta.description: A browser-only tool to place text on PDF previews and export locally.

hero.title: Place text on PDFs.
hero.lead: Place names and notes directly on the preview. Processing stays entirely in your browser.

ui.pageOnly: Changes apply only to this page.
ui.jpFontNg: Japanese font could not be loaded.
ui.chooseOrDrop: Choose a PDF or drag & drop

mechanism.summary: A local-only, page-based PDF labeling tool.
mechanism.list1: PDFs are processed on your device and never sent to a server.
mechanism.list2: Adjust positions in the preview; only that page is affected.
mechanism.list3: Export happens entirely in the browser.
mechanism.note: You get page-level control without sacrificing privacy.

legal.title: Specified Commercial Transaction Act
legal.pricingBody: The core name-printing tool is free. Custom systems or options may be charged upon request.
legal.deliveryBody: The name-printing tool is available immediately. Paid options follow a custom schedule after agreement.
legal.paymentBody: For paid services, bank transfer or online payment (e.g., Stripe) is used.
legal.refundBody: No refunds are required for the free service. Paid custom work is non-cancellable after start.
legal.environmentBody: This service runs in the browser with local-only PDF processing. Recommended: latest Chrome, Safari, Edge.
